headline: Nevish Line Erupts as Callahans Passage Rekindles
war_summary: The night edition finds fresh thunder on the Nevish Line, Colonial losses leaping past five hundred the hour against some three hundred Warden, both still climbing, though its eight posts remain in Warden keeping. Callahans Passage, lately ebbed, shows new acceleration in the small hours, its day's toll now beyond eleven thousand Colonial and near nine thousand Warden. The Dead Lands' furnace burns hotter still, Warden losses nearing sixteen hundred the hour, Colonial near nine hundred, with no base movement logged there. Mooring County turns flags latest of all, The Wind Hills again hard on three o'clock, while Stonecradle's World's End kept clerks busy past half two. The Weathered Expanse has gone silent these two hours after Frostmarch's twenty-two-event day, its five-to-four Colonial edge standing. The Linn of Mercy cools at the top hour, no flag turned since evening at Lathair; Stlican Shelf's five-Warden, four-Colonial line has not budged since dusk. Fishermans Row, wholly Colonial since its night of flux, is still since short of seven. Day 299 of the war; no victor declared, thirty-four victory towns required.
